name: integrations_feedback_exchange_status
description: Show the state of this workspace's feedback exchange with a peer system: whether it is set up (connected means enabled with a peer and both signing secrets stored; it does not prove the peer answers), the peer and its address, the last sync, the types it sends and imports as stored ("all" means every type, including any added later; an empty list means none), the types actually sent today with "all" resolved, whether the secrets and sync cursors are present, and what the import has done: records imported, updated, withdrawn and skipped, with each skip reason and the people the peer named that no Person matched at the last sync. Never returns a secret.
